test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Think on your feet

options.text: Stand up to be able to solve a problem
Be interested in trekking and running a race
Adjust quickly to changes and make fast decisions
Be ready to take up all the challenges that you face

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Adjust quickly to changes and make fast decisions'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Think on your feet**: to make a quick decision or give an answer quickly; react to events decisively, effectively, and without prior thought.

 
 
• Example: I'd never heard about the company before, so I had to** think on my feet.**
 
 
 
• Thus, from above we can say that the correct answer is **option 3.**
